title: HTML document anatomy
description: Build a complete HTML document from the doctype to the body, understanding parsing order, the document language and the main content boundary.
objectives: Identify the HTML doctype, root element, head and body
Explain the purpose of charset, viewport and document title
Write an HTML page without a framework or JavaScript dependency
Inspect the browser's parsed document tree in DevTools
rubric: I created the document skeleton and set an appropriate document language.
I inspected the actual DOM and explained the difference between metadata and visible content.
I passed the standards-mode and semantic-structure checks.
